name: Knowledge Domain
summary: Clerics of gods of lore who seek and share secrets.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.short: Two languages and two knowledge skills with double proficiency.
features.summary: You learn two languages of your choice. You become proficient in two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion, and your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with them.

grants.text: Blessings of Knowledge: double proficiency on the two chosen knowledge skills.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
features.short: Gain proficiency with any skill or tool for 10 minutes.
features.summary: As an action, choose one skill or tool. For 10 minutes you have proficiency with it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
features.short: Read a creature's surface thoughts, then cast Suggestion on it.
features.summary: As an action, choose a creature within 60 ft. It makes a WIS save; on a failure you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute and can end the effect to cast Suggestion on it without a slot (it fails automatically).

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.short: Add WIS to cleric cantrip damage.
features.summary: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.short: Meditate to see the history of an object or area.
features.summary: After at least 1 minute of meditation, you receive visions of an object's past owners or of events in your surroundings. Once per short or long rest.
